_comment: Reviewed, accepted dependency advisories (issue #115). Added 2026-11-08 from the first audit run. All remaining entries are in Developer A's packages; Developer B's web app was brought to zero advisories by upgrading maplibre-gl, vite, vitest and react-router. Remove an entry when it is fixed; an entry past review_by fails CI until re-reviewed.
